blurb: The Moraine Lake & Lake Louise Quick Escape offers a seamless half-day adventure to Canada’s most iconic lakes. Perfect for travellers (up to 14) on a tight schedule, this 5 hours private tour allows you to explore Moraine Lake and Lake Louise. Choose your own start-time, enjoy door-to-door service from Banff, Canmore, or Lake Louise in a luxury Mercedes Sprinter, complete with panoramic views. You'll have exclusive access to the lakes, allowing ample time for photography, a peaceful lakeshore stroll or even canoe. Your local guide ensures you maximize your experience while keeping the day free for more Rockies adventures.
